subject: Security review kickoff & scope - stakeholder mapping and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@acmehealth.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-08-03T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap & security kickoff - confirmation of stakeholders and scope

Thanks again for taking the time today - great conversation. Quick recap and next steps to get the security review moving so we can keep the deal timeline intact.

Recap (from our discovery):
- Primary use: Acme Health will use Redwood inference for on-demand clinical summarization in a non-prod and prod environment.
- Key constraints: low-latency (<200ms per request at 95th pct), audit logs retention, and encryption at rest/in-transit.
- Timeline ask: security review completed before EOW Aug 21 to align with procurement.

Requested confirmations (can you reply with names/emails where applicable):
1) Economic buyer / budget approver (we had Liam listed - please confirm).
2) Security/compliance owner for the review (name + best email).
3) Legal/procurement contact for contract redlines.
4) Systems in scope: please confirm whether the following are in-scope: production API endpoints, S3 buckets for artifacts, analytics Snowflake instance, and log storage (CloudWatch). Also flag any PHI-sensitive datasets.

Proposed next step: 30-minute security kickoff to walk through the questionnaire and align on evidence collection. Suggested slots: Thu Aug 6 10:00 AM PT or Fri Aug 7 9:00 AM PT - happy to adapt.

I attached our Security Questionnaire to speed things up - if you prefer, we can walk through the key questions during the kickoff and collect answers iteratively.

Thanks -
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference
(415) 555-0143

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (30 pages - questionnaire stub)

From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & security kickoff - confirmation of stakeholders and scope

Thanks Marissa - appreciate the clear recap. A few quick clarifications: 

- Economic buyer: Liam O'Connor (liam.oconnor@acmehealth.com) - confirmed.
- Security/compliance owner: Monica Singh (monica.singh@acmehealth.com) from InfoSec - she will be primary reviewer for evidence.
- Legal/procurement: I'll loop in procurement once we have a clear SOC/SLA ask; Liam will help surface the right PO contact if needed.

Systems in scope (short answer):
- Production API endpoints (yes)
- S3 buckets (yes - artifacts + model outputs)
- Snowflake analytics (yes, limited schema access)
- Logs: CloudWatch (yes)
- PHI: some datasets contain PHI; we'll need to confirm handling but treat as in-scope for security controls/HIPAA considerations.

Monica will start a parallel intake for SOC 2 evidence. We can take the questionnaire offline - Monica prefers to have our security kickoff on Thu Aug 6 at 10:00 AM PT. We'll aim to return the first-pass answers by Mon Aug 10.

Thanks,
Priya Rao
Product Lead, Data Platforms | Acme Health
priya.rao@acmehealth.com

On a related note: Monica is copying me on the initial doc she uses for vendor intake; I can share that after the kickoff.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@acmehealth.com>, Monica Singh <monica.singh@acmehealth.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-08-04T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & security kickoff - confirmation of stakeholders and scope

Perfect - thanks for the quick turnaround, Priya and Monica. Confirming Thu Aug 6 10:00 AM PT for the kickoff. I'll send a calendar invite shortly.

Agenda (30 min):
- Intros & stakeholder roles (5 min)
- High-level scope & systems (5 min)
- Walk key questionnaire sections (controls, data flows, encryption, logging) (12 min)
- Evidence & timeline / next steps (8 min)

I've attached the Redwood Security Questionnaire again and a simplified infrastructure diagram to make the kickoff efficient. If Monica has an internal intake template, sending that beforehand would be super-helpful.

Attendees from our side: Jonas Weber (Solutions Engineer) and Dylan Brooks (Customer Success) will join to cover infra and operational guarantees. Please confirm if any additional internal stakeholders should be on the call.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.redwood.inference/meet/rdw-acme-security-kickoff (placeholder link)

Thanks - looking forward to it.

-
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire.pdf, redwood-infrastructure-diagram.png

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.inference>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@acmehealth.com>, Monica Singh <monica.singh@acmehealth.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security kickoff - I'll join and bring infra notes

Thanks Marissa - I'm on for Thu Aug 6 10:00 AM PT. I'll bring the infra diagram and a short checklist of controls we typically provide (network egress, KMS integration, audit log samples, and retention policies).

Dylan - could you bring any recent SOC/pen test artifacts or pointer links we can share with Acme? I'll coordinate offline to make sure we have redwood-infra screenshots available.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.inference
